evidence: Adds functional test coverage for TRUC sibling eviction on reorgs and asserts invariants on mempool transaction resurrection during reorgs.
rationale: The PR adds regression test coverage and invariants ensuring block reorganizations do not evict existing mempool transactions or reject re-added transactions on mempool policy. Specifically, commit d223122202 targets catching regressions of CVE-2025-62861 where TRUC policy rules during a reorg stranded descendant transactions.
